title: Detailed guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shadow / depth under body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="30" ry="8" fill="#3a1a0a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="43" y="8" width="14" height="40" rx="2" fill="#c8893a"/>
  <rect x="44" y="8" width="5" height="40" fill="#e0a85c"/>
  <rect x="45" y="8" width="2" height="40" fill="#f0c080" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Frets -->
  <rect x="43" y="16" width="14" height="1.5" fill="#888"/>
  <rect x="43" y="23" width="14" height="1.5" fill="#888"/>
  <rect x="43" y="29" width="14" height="1.5" fill="#888"/>
  <rect x="43" y="34" width="14" height="1.5" fill="#888"/>
  <rect x="43" y="38" width="14" height="1.5" fill="#888"/>
  <rect x="43" y="42" width="14" height="1.5" fill="#888"/>

  <!-- Fret markers -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="19.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffe080"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="26" r="1.5" fill="#ffe080"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="31.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffe080"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="1.5" fill="#ffe080"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#ffe080"/>

  <!-- Headstock -->
  <path d="M43 8 Q40 2 42 0 L58 0 Q60 2 57 8 Z" fill="#a06820"/>
  <path d="M43 8 Q40 2 42 0 L50 0 L50 8 Z" fill="#c8893a"/>

  <!-- Tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="4" r="2.5" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="4" r="2.5" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="7" r="2" fill="#ccc"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="7" r="2" fill="#ccc"/>
  <rect x="37" y="3" width="3" height="1.5" fill="#bbb"/>
  <rect x="60" y="3" width="3" height="1.5" fill="#bbb"/>

  <!-- Nut -->
  <rect x="42" y="7.5" width="16" height="2.5" fill="#f5f0e0" rx="1"/>

  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1="46" y1="10" x2="46" y2="82" stroke="#f0f0e0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="48.7" y1="10" x2="48.7" y2="82" stroke="#f0f0e0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="51.3" y1="10" x2="51.3" y2="82" stroke="#f0f0e0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="10" x2="54" y2="82" stroke="#f0f0e0" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Upper bout -->
  <path d="M43 48 Q30 48 28 56 Q26 64 35 68 L43 68 Z" fill="#d49040"/>
  <path d="M57 48 Q70 48 72 56 Q74 64 65 68 L57 68 Z" fill="#d49040"/>
  <path d="M35 68 Q30 70 30 74 Q30 80 38 82 L43 82 Z" fill="#c07830"/>

  <!-- Lower bout -->
  <path d="M35 68 Q22 68 20 78 Q18 88 30 90 Q35 90 38 88 L43 82" fill="#d49040"/>
  <path d="M65 68 Q78 68 80 78 Q82 88 70 90 Q65 90 62 88 L57 82" fill="#d49040"/>

  <!-- Body center fill -->
  <path d="M43 48 L57 48 L57 68 L65 68 Q78 68 80 78 Q82 88 70 90 L62 88 Q55 92 50 92 Q45 92 38 88 L30 90 Q18 88 20 78 Q22 68 35 68 L43 68 Z" fill="#d49040"/>

  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <path d="M43 50 L57 50 L57 66 L64 66 Q76 66 78 76 L64 76 Q57 72 50 72 Q43 72 36 76 L22 76 Q24 66 36 66 L43 66 Z" fill="#e8a858" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Waist binding -->
  <path d="M35 68 Q30 70 30 74 Q30 80 38 82" fill="none" stroke="#f0c060" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M65 68 Q70 70 70 74 Q70 80 62 82" fill="none" stroke="#f0c060" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Sound hole -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="9" fill="#3a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#f0c060" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#e8a858" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Rosette pattern -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="10.5" fill="none" stroke="#f5d080" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="2 1.5"/>

  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x="42" y="80" width="16" height="4" rx="1" fill="#5a2a0a"/>
  <rect x="42" y="80" width="16" height="1.5" rx="0.5" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
  <rect x="44" y="77" width="12" height="3" rx="1" fill="#f0f0e0"/>
  <rect x="44" y="77" width="12" height="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Bridge pins -->
  <circle cx="45.5" cy="81.5" r="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="81.5" r="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <circle cx="51.5" cy="81.5" r="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <circle cx="54.5" cy="81.5" r="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>

  <!-- Pickguard -->
  <path d="M40 50 Q32 52 32 60 Q32 66 40 66 L40 50 Z" fill="#2a1a0a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Decorative edge highlight -->
  <path d="M21 78 Q22 70 32 68" fill="none" stroke="#f0c060" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M79 78 Q78 70 68 68" fill="none" stroke="#f0c060" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Strap button -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="90" r="2" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="90" r="1" fill="#aaa"/>
</svg>
